question: Create a single-page SVG showcase of an Indian auto rickshaw (tuk-tuk). Make the vehicle the dominant focal object and visibly include its three-wheel structure, enclosed passenger cabin, driver windshield, canopy roof, headlamp, mirrors, handlebars, mudguards, and small ornamental details. Use convincing three-quarter perspective, layered shading, and a lively street-inspired palette. Put strong emphasis on a coherent composition, precise vector craft, dimensionality, and polished finish.

Create a single-page SVG showcase of a traditional Japanese kimono. Center the full garment silhouette and visibly include the T-shaped sleeves, crossed collar, wide obi sash, layered fabric, and an authentic nature-inspired repeating pattern. Use graceful folds, subtle depth, balanced negative space, and a restrained Japanese color palette. Put strong emphasis on elegant proportions, cultural specificity, visual coherence, and refined vector craft.

Design the main gameplay screen (a single page) for a fast downhill Sliding Challenge game. Include a dramatic icy slope as the focal play field, a rider in motion, a clearly readable route, gates and obstacles ahead, speed and distance HUD, directional controls, and a compact progress indicator. Put strong emphasis on the sensation of speed, immediate obstacle readability, a distinct alpine identity, clear hierarchy, and polished visual finish.

Design the main gameplay screen (a single page) for a polished offline dinosaur runner inspired by the familiar browser game. Include a side-view running dinosaur, layered desert ground, cacti and a flying obstacle, score and high-score HUD, a small speed indicator, and a clear jump instruction. Put strong emphasis on crisp silhouette readability, rhythmic spacing, a distinctive modern-retro identity, and a coherent, highly polished composition rather than a bare clone.

Design the main screen (a single page) for a digital Rubik's Cube puzzle called The Cube. Make a large dimensional scrambled cube the centerpiece, with visible colored stickers and convincing 3D face relationships. Include cube-size selectors for 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5; move count and timer; Scramble, Undo, Hint, and Reset controls; and a compact formula/tip panel. Put strong emphasis on spatial clarity, tactile controls, coherent color, and a professional puzzle-product finish.

Design the main gameplay screen (a single page) for a Crossy Road-style road-crossing game. Include a charming animal player, several horizontal terrain lanes, moving cars or trucks, a river or grass safety strip, score and best-score HUD, and compact four-direction controls. Use perspective and scale to make the crossing route immediately legible. Put strong emphasis on playful low-poly character, clear hazards, depth, color rhythm, and a polished game-ready composition.

Design the main screen (a single page) for an Enemy AI behavior demonstration. Include a top-down tactical arena with the player, several enemies, walls and obstacles, visible patrol or path lines, detection cones, attack ranges, and distinct AI-state labels such as PATROL, ALERT, CHASE, and ATTACK. Add a compact inspector panel with player health and AI legend. Put strong emphasis on making tracking, pathfinding, and state transitions visually understandable while maintaining a cohesive, polished tactical identity.

Design the main screen (a single page) for a Magic Academy learning game. Include an atmospheric academy hall or study scene, a student profile with rank and progress, a curriculum of magical course cards, a prominent current lesson, an upcoming exam panel, spell mastery indicators, and one clear Learn or Practice action. Put strong emphasis on an enchanting scholarly identity, readable progression, meaningful card differentiation, elegant typography, and polished visual craft.

Create a single-page SVG infographic of a computer system and the information moving through it. Include clearly labeled CPU, memory, storage, GPU, input, output, and network components, with directional connectors that distinguish data, instructions, and control signals. Establish a strong title, legend, grouping, and visual hierarchy so the architecture can be understood at a glance. Put strong emphasis on information clarity, consistent diagram language, precise alignment, restrained color coding, and professional technical polish.

Design a single-page introduction screen for a colorful side-scrolling platform adventure inspired by classic mascot platformers. Include a bold original game title, a hero beside a layered level preview with platforms, blocks, coins, enemies, and a distant goal, plus a prominent Start Adventure button, small controls guide, world selector, and collectible counters. Put strong emphasis on a joyful original identity, clear gameplay storytelling, depth, expressive shapes, and a polished launch-screen composition.

Create a single-page SVG product-style scene of a clean white sign featuring a recognizable red play-button video emblem. Show the sign as a physical object with believable thickness, mounting hardware or stand, soft shadow, and a minimal studio or storefront context. Keep the emblem geometrically crisp and dominant without using external image assets. Put strong emphasis on proportion, pristine white material, red-and-white contrast, dimensional lighting, and polished commercial presentation.

Create a single-page SVG product illustration of a modern toilet with a clearly visible flush handle or button. Show the tank, lid, seat, bowl, plumbing base, and flusher in convincing proportion, with ceramic highlights and subtle shading. Include a tasteful bathroom context and a small visual cue that communicates flushing action, while keeping the toilet the clear focal object. Put strong emphasis on dimensionality, material realism, clean composition, and refined vector finish.

Create a single-page SVG close-up of a person holding a smartphone in one hand. Make the hand-phone interaction the focal point: fingers must convincingly wrap around and support the device, with visible thumb placement, joints, nails, screen edge, camera or speaker details, and reflected light. Use a cropped editorial composition, natural skin and device shading, and a subtle background. Put strong emphasis on believable anatomy, contact points, depth, and polished illustrative craft.

Design a single-page SVG interface for a polished domino game called Play with Tiles. Include a central tabletop with a readable chain of matched dominoes, a player's hand or tile rack, a draw pile, turn and score indicators, and a small rule or match-value cue. Make pip counts, tile orientation, and legal continuation points instantly legible. Put strong emphasis on tactile materials, strategic clarity, balanced composition, and a distinctive, professional board-game identity.

Create a single-page SVG botanical study of a green clover. Make one detailed three-leaf clover the dominant specimen, with three heart-shaped leaflets, a curved stem, visible veins, subtle serration and natural color variation. Add a few restrained scientific or field-note accents without competing with the plant. Put strong emphasis on organic silhouette, believable botanical detail, layered green tones, generous negative space, and refined vector finish.

Create a single-page SVG action scene of a person descending beside a dramatic cliff with an open parachute. Clearly show the cliff edge and rock layers, the suspended human figure, taut harness lines, a fully inflated canopy, wind or motion cues, and distant landscape depth. Compose the scene so the relationship between height, danger, and safe descent is immediately readable. Put strong emphasis on dynamic scale, clear silhouette, atmospheric depth, and polished editorial illustration.

Design the main screen (a single page) for a custom rule-based board game generator. Include a large generated board preview as the focal area, a structured rule editor panel, controls for board size and initial layout, a few rule toggles or parameter fields, a compact validation summary, and prominent Generate Board and Start Game actions. Put strong emphasis on making complex configuration approachable through hierarchy, grouping, feedback, and a polished tabletop-tool identity.

Design the main screen (a single page) for an in-game friends and party system. Include a player profile header, searchable friends list with avatars and online states, pending requests, a selected-friend detail panel, and clear Add Friend, Invite to Game, and Battle actions. Show at least one active party or invitation state. Put strong emphasis on social clarity, status legibility, warm personality, coherent component design, and polished game-interface finish.
